title: Observability Ingest v2 Object Reference
description: Authenticated, content-addressed reference to a large input/output payload stored out-of-band (14-observability-ingest-v2 §2.1/§2.2). v2 event bodies are capped at 64 KiB after canonicalization, so large input/output is NEVER inlined on the wire — it is carried as this reference and verified by the materializer against `byte_count` and `sha256`. The referenced object is user content; this reference metadata itself carries no inline content.

key.description: Opaque, tenant/project-scoped storage key for the referenced object. Resolution scope comes from the authenticated credential, never from this key.

byte_count.description: Exact byte length of the referenced object, verified by the materializer.

content_type.description: IANA media type of the referenced object (e.g. application/json, text/plain).
